content.title: What are the key highlights of the Data Science programs?
content: Our programs feature expert-led sessions, real-world case studies, hands-on projects, and certification from renowned institutes in the country.

content.title: How do I choose the right Data Science program for me?
content: Consider your career goals, experience level, and industry interests. Our advisors can help guide your choice.

content.title: Are these programs suitable for beginners in Data Science?
content: Yes, we offer programs for all experience levels—whether you're starting out or looking to advance your career.

content.title: Do I get access to course materials after the program ends?
content: Yes, participants have access to course materials and session recordings via the LMS for a specified period.

content.title: Are the programs offered online or in a hybrid format?
content: The programs are delivered 100% live online, offering flexibility and interactive learning experiences.

content.title: What is the duration of these programs?
content: Program durations typically range from 5 months to a year, depending on the institute.

content.title: Can I enroll in multiple programs simultaneously?
content: Yes, but it is recommended to speak with our advisors to manage workloads effectively and align the programs with your goals.

content.title: Are there any prerequisites for enrolling in these programs?
content: Some programs may require prior experience, while others are open to all professionals.

content.title: How will these programs help in my career advancement?
content: The programs equip you with practical skills, industry knowledge, and credentials to enhance your career prospects in data science.

content.title: Will I receive a certificate after completing the program?
content: Yes, you will receive a certificate of completion.
